title:
Saffron liquidity incentives
Portable installation guide
description: Home, Portfolio and Live APR with an independent incentives API and automatic vault lifecycle.
meta: Version 0.3.0 · Explicit simulation and live builds · Source identity in the archive manifest

sections.title: 1. Standalone application
sections.body_html:
The combined Home, Portfolio and Live APR interface includes mobile navigation and transaction dialogs. Production uses the canonical incentives API maintained in this repository. Configure real campaigns and operating owners before paid intake.

Open the app · Live APR · Portable source ZIP

sections.title: 2. Current lifecycle
sections.body_html:
Claim $X retains the incentive wording. A separate $2-equivalent native ETH fee on Robinhood requests automatic creation. Four verified stages lead to external premium funding, fixed-side LP entry, incentive claim and mature withdrawal.

Vault TVL values deposited campaign principal; APR keeps separate Pool TVL. Refund administration verifies full original-fee payouts paid externally. Private advisory targets do not cap requests.

sections.title: 3. Install and run
sections.body_html:
Use Node 22.9 or newer and npm. Extract the source ZIP, enter its folder and run:

npm ci
npm run dev

npm run build writes an explicit simulation to dist/. build:lab adds appearance controls. Serve output through HTTP(S). No backend checkout is required to build the archive.

sections.title: 4. Live mode and routing
sections.body_html:
Put public settings in .env.local:

VITE_BASE_PATH=/
VITE_LIVE_APR_API_BASE=/api/live-apr/v2
VITE_UI_TWEAKS=false

npm run build:live writes dist-live/. Serve through the canonical backend with matching BASE_PATH and DIST_DIR. Configure its independent database, watcher and creator. Backend services and credentials are excluded from this frontend ZIP.

Preserve same-origin API/RPC/prices, cookies, unbuffered APR SSE, SPA routes and real missing-file 404s. Hosting provides staging access. Appearance controls never select the payment adapter; live mode never falls back to samples.

sections.title: 5. Navigation and recovery
sections.body_html:
Home: /; Portfolio: /portfolio/vaults; operators: /campaigns and /admin; pool observations: /live-apr. Up to four pools can be compared.

Payment and position recovery survives reloads without automatic wallet sends. Full premium funding and actual ownership govern safe entry and later actions. APR outages remain explicitly unavailable while independently ready vault actions remain usable. Preview reset affects only its simulation.

Initial mobile use is through a wallet browser. Real phones require qualification; WalletConnect remains desired future work.

sections.title: 6. Application boundaries
sections.body_html: One router, shell, theme and modal layer serve the public UI. Vendored sources and licenses are included. No other application is a build or runtime dependency. APR/PNG code loads when needed. The API and watcher are keyless; the separate creator only creates and initializes vaults. Premium and refund payments are external operator responsibilities.

sections.title: 7. Verification
sections.body_html:
npm run check:upstream
npm run test:source
npm test
npm run typecheck
npx playwright install chromium
npm run build:live
npm run test:apr-http

For preview checks, run build:lab, set MERGE_BASE=/ for a root mount and run test:browser. Follow docs/LIFECYCLE-ACCEPTANCE.md for the disposable backend tests on mobile and desktop.

Controlled HTTP/SSE tests qualify client behavior, not the deployed gateway. Hosted-browser, real phone, normal HTTPS clipboard and explicitly operated live-funds acceptance remain launch gates. Disposable time advancement does not establish real maturity.

sections.title: 8. Source and release identity
sections.body_html:
source-files.json defines the inventory. source-manifest.json records version, Git revision, normalized source digest and exact file hashes. Shared pins normalize CRLF to LF; archive integrity verifies exact bytes.

python scripts/verify_source.py
python scripts/render_install.py

The ZIP includes the lockfile, tests, portable scripts and licenses, excluding runtime settings, credentials, dependencies, build output and other ZIPs. Regenerate this guide from docs/install-guide.json.

sections.title: 9. Release and rollback
sections.body_html:
Follow docs/DEPLOYMENT.md and docs/LIVE-CUTOVER.md. Build identity does not establish publication or enabled intake. Verify the intended candidate through existing hosting access before cutover.

Publish hashed assets before the entrypoint and retain old assets for open tabs. Preserve database/WAL, received fees, watcher cursors, journals, permits and browser recovery. Use a backend compatible with advisory commitments and refund closure. Do not restore the old hard-cap schema or reset QA for a frontend release.
